subject: Important Update: Changes to Your Account Settings
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some important updates we've made to our platform. To enhance security, we have added a two-step verification process for all accounts. You will now be required to verify your identity using a unique code sent to your registered email or phone number. These changes are aimed at protecting your account and personal information. Please ensure you update your settings accordingly to avoid any disruptions to your service. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
